in_sanskrit.name: Ashit
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Morning Sun
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ashit एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ashit is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘asheshta’, meaning ‘eighth’. In Hindu mythology, the sun is considered the eighth deity and is symbolized by the god Surya. The name Ashit signifies the arrival of the morning sun, bringing new hope and energy.
